主模型卡片直接显示正在处理的任务、计时、当前步骤和排队的任务，原来的「正在处理的: The Main model card shows the task in progress with its clock, the current step and queued tasks; the separate tasks card is folded into it.
阅读视图输入框里粘贴的每张图片都有自己的移除按钮，删一张不影响其他图片和文字。: Each image pasted into the reading-view composer has its own remove button; removing one keeps the other images and your text.
选择助手时显示 Claude 和 Codex 的官方图标；Claude Code: Choosing an assistant shows the official Claude and Codex marks; list bullets in a Claude Code project use Claude's orange.

每个模型的标题行显示思考深度和输出模式，Claude 子代理也有；不再重复显示「: Each model head shows its effort and output mode, Claude sub-agents included; the repeated “sub-agent” tag and official provider name are gone.
